roleHelp.admin: Manages members and the audit log, plus everything an editor does.
roleHelp.editor: Creates and edits sites and secrets, uploads, renames and deletes files.
roleHelp.viewer: Browses and downloads only. Cannot see or change secrets.

page.title: Members
page.subtitle: People who can open the sites of {{name}}. Roles decide what each one can do.
page.personalTitle: Personal workspaces have no other members
page.personalBody: Create a team workspace to share sites with other people.

matrix.title: What each role can do
matrix.sites: Create and edit sites and secrets
matrix.members: Manage members and read the audit log

keysNote.title: Keys and membership
keysNote.body: Every member gets their own sealed copy of the workspace key. A member marked Waiting for vault has not set up their vault yet: someone with an unlocked vault hands the key over when they do. Removing someone rotates the key and seals every stored secret again.

invite.title: Invite to {{name}}
invite.step1: Step 1 of 2. The invitation only works for this email address.
invite.step2: Step 2 of 2. Transferly sends no email: share this link yourself.
invite.onlyOnce: The link is shown once and cannot be recovered. Anyone holding it who signs in as {{email}} can join. You can revoke it from the Invitations tab.

remove.title: Remove {{email}}?
remove.rotation: The workspace key will be rotated
remove.rotationBody: A new key is created and sealed for the members that stay. The stored secrets are sealed again with it.
remove.change: This person could have copied credentials while they were a member. Change the passwords of the sites of this workspace at their servers.

transfer.title: Transfer ownership
transfer.body: A workspace has one owner. After the transfer you become an admin and cannot undo it yourself.
transfer.onlySealed: Only members whose key is sealed can be chosen.
transfer.confirmLabel: Type the workspace name to confirm
transfer.noCandidates: No member can receive the workspace yet.

leave.title: Leave {{name}}?
leave.body: You lose access to its sites and files. An admin can invite you again.

newTeam.title: New team workspace
newTeam.body: You become its owner. Its key is sealed with your vault, so it has to be unlocked.
newTeam.name: Name

accept.label: Invitation
accept.missing: The link has no invitation token.
accept.title: You were invited to {{name}}
accept.asRole: You will join as {{role}}. Your personal workspace stays private.
accept.vaultNote: Next you will create a master password for your vault. It is a different secret from this one and protects the credentials of every workspace you use.
accept.wrongAccount: This invitation is for {{email}}, but you are signed in as {{current}}. Sign out and open the link again.
accept.sameHint: If the link was used, expired or was sent to another address, this page cannot tell you which.

audit.title: Audit log
audit.subtitle: What changed in {{name}} and who did it. Only admins and the owner can read it.
audit.noAccess: Only admins and the owner can read the audit log.
audit.personal: Personal workspaces have no team audit log.
